title: Block file scheme in Web Request Helper
summary: Web Request Helper now rejects file:// URLs before creating HTTP requests to prevent unauthorized local file access through crafted URLs.
key_points: Blocks the file URI scheme in GetResponseTextInternal before HttpWebRequest.Create is called
Callers get a false return instead of an unhandled error
No behavior change for http and https URLs
Reuses the existing IsValidUri check, so invalid URIs now fail earlier
Security fix that stops crafted URLs from reading files on the server
